column1: # Recovered structure layouts, shared by all modules. Columns: struct, offset (hex), type,
# field name, comment. Types are as in names.tsv ("base" plus "*" per pointer level), with
# "[N]" for arrays. Structures are packed; gaps stay undefined.
# infio_t: race data passed between A2MENU.DAT and A2SPEL.DAT through INFIO.INI.
# Field order and names follow save_infio's INI keys (Dutch keys in comments).
# opponent_t: one 0x100-byte entry per car on the road (player, rivals, police, traffic);
# opponent_data points to an array of them. Unclear fields keep field_XX.

column5: index into the car type table
copied from the car type table
4 bounding-box corners (x, y, z), rotated by heading
the same corners relative to the car
road chunk the car is on
0 or 1, driving direction along the road

column1: # racer_object_t: one 0x4b-byte (packed) entry per 3D object; racers points to an array.

column5: cleared for the player's car in cockpit view

column1: # weg_section_t: one 0x54-byte road section; weg_sections points to an array.

column5: road plane: height = -(a*x + c*z + d) / b

column1: # form_t: one control on a menu form (forms.cpp); tables like mm_form end with x = -1.

column5: initial/current control state (4 becomes 1 on create)
child window created for the control

column1: # button_t: packed 21-byte button record (buttons.cpp), pointed to by form_t.control.

column5: anim index of the button graphics
anim played while focused, -1 for none

column1: # help_t: help text for a control id (help.cpp); tables end with id -1.
# anim_t: one menu animation (animbase.cpp); anims and xvga_anims are arrays of them.
# opties_t: the option settings, saved as OPTIE.A2R (20 bytes) and in each save slot.

column5: 0 music and effects, 1 effects only, 2 off, 3 music only

column1: # bedien_t: control settings (bedien.cpp), saved as BEDIEN.A2R and in each save slot.
# slot_t: one of ten player save slots (slot.cpp); results are kept per stage (6).

column5: finishing position per stage, 6 = not raced

column1: # areabutton_t: packed 17-byte clickable area (areabuts.cpp), pointed to by form_t.control.

column5: anim drawn at creation, -1 for none

column1: # mst_slot_t / mns_slot_t: screen position of a save slot row (m_start.cpp, m_nsplr.cpp).
# edit_box_t: a text entry field (editbox.cpp), pointed to by form_t.control (types 0 and 3).
# mc_keyset_t: a key that can be assigned, with its name (m_bedien.cpp key_list).
# mc_config_key_t: one key setting on the controls screen (m_bedien.cpp config_key).
